name: WorkflowTask

fields.name: Name
fields.description: Task name/identifier (must be unique within workflow).

fields.name: Kind
fields.description: Task type (determines how to interpret task_config).

fields.name: Export
fields.description:
Export configuration (how to save task output to context).
 Optional - if not set, output is not saved.

fields.name: Flow
fields.description:
Flow control (which task executes next).
 Optional - if not set, continues to next task in sequence.
